## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for a user? Link a related issue if useful.

## Validation

How did you check it? Use simulated GPIOs for automated tests and say explicitly
whether any real hardware was used. For diagrams, check physical and BCM numbering.

## Screenshots or notes

For visible changes, add a reviewed screenshot or describe the result. Remove
credentials, personal paths, private logs and identifying photo metadata first.

English or German is welcome. See [the contribution guide](https://github.com/LakeGriffin85/raspi-gpio-tool/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
